title: Week 4 Puma + Mound
rules: Speed + EV stay the training program

exercises.name: 90/90 Floss
exercises.desc: 2 x 45-60 sec each side. Do this in the room if practice is already long.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.desc: 2 x 12 each. Band behind the knee, squeeze the quad straight. No pain through the load.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction hold
exercises.desc: 2 x 20-25 sec each. Quiet core. Skip if the hip is already cooked from practice.

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands — 11-exercise circuit
exercises.desc: Always before the first throw. Dual-arm: overhead extensions, side + diagonal stretch holds, forward fly, reverse fly. Throwing arm: IR, ER, elevated IR, elevated ER, reverse throw, forward throw. Walk closer to the fence if it is heavy. Do not stretch the band more than 2-3x length.

exercises.name: Reverse Throw
exercises.desc: 8 each. Face away from the target, reverse the arm path, stay long. Recovery, not velo.

exercises.name: Pivot Pick
exercises.desc: 8 each. Pivot, pick the ball, easy flip. No grunt.

exercises.name: Catch warm-up
exercises.desc: If you have leather weighted balls: 6 oz x 8, 4 oz x 8, then white 5 oz. Stay at 50-60%. No long toss today. No crow-hop maxes.

exercises.name: Post-throw circuit x 3
exercises.desc: Rebounders / plyo-ball drops 10, band pull-aparts 12, waiter walks 15 yd, upward tosses 8. Easy.

exercises.name: 10-min nasal walk + feed
exercises.desc: Protein + carbs within 60 min. Keep sipping.

exercises.name: Everyday Dynamic Warm-up
exercises.desc: Full movement prep. Look springy, not tired.

exercises.name: A-Skip + falling starts
exercises.desc: 2 x 15 yd A-skip. Then 4 x 10-20 yd accel. Full walk-back. This is the speed day — 60 still has to get under 7.00.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.desc: High elbows. Leave 2 reps in the tank. One working squat session this week.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.desc: Long reverse step, front heel down, torso tall. Control the knee — do not sink into a depth you cannot own.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Soft knee, hips back. Posterior chain without pounding the knee.

exercises.name: Spanish squat or wall-sit iso
exercises.desc: Knee-friendly strength. Stop if it pinches.

exercises.name: Copenhagen + dead bug
exercises.desc: Copenhagen 2 x 20-25 sec each. Dead bug 2 x 6 each. Core has been a little soft — anti-extension first.

sections.title: BEFORE PRACTICE — J-Bands + Hybrid B Plyos

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands — 11-exercise circuit
exercises.desc: Before the first throw. Controlled pace. Fatigue, not failure.

exercises.name: Reverse Throw @ 50%
exercises.desc: Long, quiet arm. Heavy ball first, then the 450g.

exercises.name: Pivot Pick @ 50%
exercises.desc: Same two balls. Easy pick and throw.

exercises.name: Rocker series @ 70-80%
exercises.desc: 3 each color, no rest between colors. One pass. Stay on plane. No purple / 1500g.

exercises.name: Walking wind-up @ 70-80%
exercises.meta: YELLOW 225g / 8 oz • ORANGE 150g / 5.3 oz • RED 100g / 3.5 oz
exercises.desc: 3 each. Step and throw. Command over grunt.

exercises.name: Jaeger long toss — extension only
exercises.desc: Work out, get air under it, work back in. No pulldowns. No throws on a line at max. This is Hybrid B.

exercises.name: INF feeds
exercises.desc: Forehand, backhand, one DP turn. 70-80%. Keep the 91. Do not airmail it in warm-ups.

sections.title: HITTING — If the team did not already cover it

exercises.name: Walk-Through Drill
exercises.desc: 3 swings each bat = 12.

exercises.name: Rocker Drill
exercises.desc: 3 swings each bat = 12.

exercises.name: Tee – Middle
exercises.desc: 3 swings each bat. Hunt the barrel. EV still chasing 105.

exercises.name: Front Toss – Middle / Away
exercises.desc: 3-4 each bat.

exercises.name: Machine – FB + Slider mix
exercises.desc: Regular bat. 8-10 FB + 8-10 slider. Stop when quality drops.

exercises.name: Post-throw circuit x 3
exercises.desc: Rebounders / plyo drops 10, pull-aparts 12, waiter walks 15 yd, upward tosses 8.

exercises.name: Band ER + 90/90
exercises.desc: ER 2 x 12 each. 90/90 floss 2 x 45 sec.

exercises.name: Everyday Dynamic + shoulder CARs
exercises.desc: Add 6 slow CARs each shoulder before the press work.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.desc: Do this after throwing if the arm is hot — or before if you throw later. Leave 2 in the tank.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.desc: Squeeze the scaps. Do not shrug.

exercises.name: Landmine or half-kneeling press
exercises.desc: Own the ribcage. This feeds the throw and the swing.

exercises.name: Face pull + Pallof press
exercises.desc: Anti-rotation for the soft core. Pause the Pallof.

exercises.name: Med-Ball rotational throw
exercises.desc: Max intent, stick the finish. EV work lives here too.

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands — 11-exercise circuit
exercises.desc: Before the first throw. Same circuit as Tuesday.

exercises.name: Reverse Throw @ 50%
exercises.desc: No rocker series today. Save the arm for the short box.

exercises.name: Pivot Pick @ 50%
exercises.desc: Easy. Then go catch.

sections.title: BEFORE PRACTICE — Catch + 15-20 Pitch Short Box

exercises.name: Catch + short extension toss
exercises.desc: Get out to a comfortable extension distance. Work back in. No pulldowns.

exercises.name: Short box / light pen — 15-20 pitches
exercises.desc: Catcher in front of the plate or a shortened mound. Mix FB / slider / one change if you have it. Command the glove. Last 4-5 at game effort — then stop. This is Mound Blend B, not a starter bullpen.

exercises.name: INF only if the arm is quiet
exercises.desc: If the pen left the arm buzzed, skip INF extra. The 91 shows up Saturday, not in extra feeds.

exercises.name: Walk-Through + Rocker
exercises.desc: 3 each bat on each drill.

exercises.name: Tee – Away
exercises.desc: 3-4 each bat.

exercises.name: Machine – FB / curve mix
exercises.desc: Regular bat. 16-20 total. Puma will mix looks.

exercises.name: Post-throw circuit x 3
exercises.desc: Rebounders, pull-aparts, waiter walks, upward tosses.

exercises.name: Forearm + ER extras
exercises.desc: Band ER 2 x 12. Wrist pro/sup 2 x 12. You touched the mound — take care of the elbow.

sections.title: ON ITS OWN — Optional Core + TKE

exercises.name: Dead bug + side plank
exercises.desc: Dead bug 2 x 6 each. Side plank 2 x 20-25 sec each. Stop there.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.desc: Only if the knee is calm. No extra squat or hinge today.

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands — short circuit
exercises.desc: Full 11 if you have time. If not: forward fly, reverse fly, IR, ER, elevated IR, elevated ER.

exercises.name: Reverse Throw @ 50%
exercises.desc: Leave the 1000g in the bag today.

exercises.name: Pivot Pick @ 50%
exercises.desc: Recovery day = reverse + pivot only. No rocker. No wind-up.

sections.title: BEFORE PRACTICE — Light Catch, No Long Toss

exercises.name: Catch play 40-50 throws
exercises.desc: Recovery day: light catch is plenty. No long toss. No mound.

exercises.name: Walk-Through + Tee middle
exercises.desc: 2-3 each bat. Done when it feels right.

exercises.name: Post-throw circuit x 2
exercises.desc: Pull-aparts, waiter walks, upward tosses. Two rounds is enough.

exercises.name: Couch stretch + 90/90
exercises.desc: Lights out on time. Friday is a hard stop.

sections.title: ON ITS OWN — Pattern Primer Only

exercises.name: Everyday Dynamic
exercises.desc: Just enough to feel springy.

exercises.name: Build-ups + 2 starts
exercises.desc: 3 x 15 yd at 70-80%, then 2 x 10 yd at 90%. Full recovery. Stop.

exercises.name: Goblet squat + reverse lunge groove
exercises.desc: Goblet 2 x 3. Reverse lunge 2 x 4 each. Activation, not Tuesday.

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands — short circuit
exercises.desc: Same six: flies + IR/ER up and down.

exercises.name: Easy catch 25-40 throws
exercises.desc: If the arm is fresh and you have a catcher, 8-12 easy short-box pitches at 60-70% is allowed. If anything is tight — catch only. No long toss.

exercises.name: 4-6 easy INF
exercises.desc: Feel the hop. Save the firm throw for tomorrow.

exercises.name: Walk-Through + Rocker
exercises.desc: 2 each bat on each drill.

exercises.name: 3-minute visualization
exercises.desc: See the first at-bat at Grand Park. See a clean first-step. See the 1-2-3 inning — strike one, weak contact, get the out.

exercises.name: Bag check
exercises.desc: Cleats, game bat, J-Band, plyos if coaches allow them at the park, extra socks, snacks, water.

exercises.name: Hard stop
exercises.desc: No extra lift. No extra cages. Eat, hydrate, lights out.

exercises.name: Sleep + wake check
exercises.desc: 8-9 hours. Two alarms on the road.

exercises.name: Hydration + breakfast
exercises.desc: 16-24 oz water. Protein + carb 2.5-3 hrs before first pitch.

exercises.name: Weigh-in if you can
exercises.desc: Log it. Same protocol as Scout Day.

sections.title: BEFORE THE GAME — J-Bands + Field Primer

exercises.name: Jaeger J-Bands
exercises.desc: Before the first official throw. Do not skip this because it is a game day.

exercises.name: Everyday Dynamic + build-ups
exercises.desc: Team warm-up + 2-3 x 15 yd at 70-80% + 2 x 10 yd at 90%.

exercises.name: Catch + INF as the team does it
exercises.desc: Do not long-toss the arm out before the inning. Get loose, show the arm on the throws you need, then sit. If you pitch Game 1, treat pregame catch like a reliever — enough to be sharp, not a second pen.

exercises.name: INF — first step, not first look
exercises.desc: Quiet feet into the pitch. Beat the ball. Show 91 when you have the throw — do not force it.

exercises.name: Swing — see it, stay through it
exercises.desc: One swing thought. Middle-away is still damage. Loud contact over pretty misses.

exercises.name: The inning
exercises.desc: Strike one. Work fast. Attack the zone you warmed up. Get the three outs and go back to short.

exercises.name: Puma Classic — Game 1
exercises.desc: Play the inning. Play the infield. Extra swings only if a coach asks.

exercises.name: 10-20 min flush walk
exercises.desc: Nasal. Shake the inning out before the next game or the bus.

exercises.name: High-intent post-throw circuit
exercises.desc: Because you pitched: band IR + ER 2 x 10, prone Y 2 x 8, rebounders / drops 10, pull-aparts 12, waiter walks, forearm pro/sup 2 x 12. Then feed.

exercises.name: Feed + fluids + W/L/T
exercises.desc: Protein + carbs within 60 min. Write: body, at-bats, the inning, one cleanup for Dinger Classic.

exercises.name: 20-min easy flush
exercises.desc: Nasal only. Conversation pace. Off days are off days. Do not throw.

exercises.name: 4-6-8 breathing
exercises.desc: In 4, hold 6, out 8. 6-8 rounds.

exercises.name: 90/90 + couch + worlds greatest
exercises.desc: Slow. Soft tissue hips / T-spine / feet 6-8 min if you want it.

exercises.name: Easy band ER + pull-aparts only
exercises.desc: 2 x 12 ER, 2 x 15 pull-aparts. Blood flow, not a workout.

exercises.name: Protein + fluids + 9 hours
exercises.desc: This is the training. Next up: Dinger Classic, Friday Sep 18.
